pergunta: How many heads of the departments are older than 56 ?
sql_gerado: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.head_id) FROM management AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.Department_ID WHERE T2.Num_Employees > 0 AND T2.Age > 56
sql_gold: SELECT count(*) FROM head WHERE age  >  56

pergunta: List the name, born state and age of the heads of departments ordered by age.
sql_gerado: SELECT T1.name , T2.born_state , T2.age FROM management AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.department_ID = T2.Department_ID ORDER BY T2.age
sql_gold: SELECT name ,  born_state ,  age FROM head ORDER BY age

pergunta: What are the names of the heads who are born outside the California state?
sql_gerado: SELECT T2.name FROM management AS T1 JOIN head AS T2 ON T1.head_ID = T2.head_ID WHERE T2.born_state != 'California'
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM head WHERE born_state != 'California'

pergunta: What are the distinct creation years of the departments managed by a secretary born in state 'Alabama'?
sql_gerado:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Creation 
FROM department AS T1 
JOIN management AS T2 ON T1.Department_ID = T2.department_ID 
JOIN head AS T3 ON T2.head_ID = T3.head_ID 
WHERE T3.born_state = 'Alabama'
sql_gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.creation FROM department AS T1 JOIN management AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id JOIN head AS T3 ON T2.head_id  =  T3.head_id WHERE T3.born_state  =  'Alabama'

pergunta: What are the names of the states where at least 3 heads were born?
sql_gerado: SELECT T1.born_state FROM head AS T1 JOIN management AS T2 ON T1.head_id = T2.head_id GROUP BY T1.born_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
sql_gold: SELECT born_state FROM head GROUP BY born_state HAVING count(*)  >=  3

pergunta: List the states where both the secretary of 'Treasury' department and the secretary of 'Homeland Security' were born.

sql_gold: SELECT T3.born_state FROM department AS T1 JOIN management AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id JOIN head AS T3 ON T2.head_id  =  T3.head_id WHERE T1.name  =  'Treasury' INTERSECT SELECT T3.

pergunta: Which department has more than 1 head at a time? List the id, name and the number of heads.
sql_gerado: SELECT D.Department_ID , D.Name , COUNT(M.head_ID) FROM department D JOIN management M ON D.Department_ID = M.department_ID GROUP BY D.Department_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT M.head_ID) > 1
sql_gold: SELECT T1.department_id ,  T1.name ,  count(*) FROM management AS T2 JOIN department AS T1 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id GROUP BY T1.department_id HAVING count(*)  >  1
